dimensions.title: Garden Dimensions
dimensions.description: Enter the size of your garden and choose your preferred measurement unit.

style.title: Garden Style
style.description: Choose the overall style that best reflects your vision.

structures.title: Existing Structures
structures.description: Mark any existing buildings, walls or structures in your garden.
structures.hint: You can draw polygons directly on the map or skip this step.

goals.title: Garden Goals
goals.description: What do you want to achieve with your garden? Select all that apply.

location.title: Garden Location
location.description: Optionally find your garden on the map to help with sizing and positioning.
location.noResults: No results found. Try a more specific address.
location.searchFailed: Search failed. Please check your connection and try again.
location.mapPlaceholder: Search for an address to see it on the map
location.optional: This step is optional — you can skip it and configure dimensions manually on the canvas.

boundary.title: Draw Your Garden
boundary.description: Trace your garden boundary on the satellite map. Works for any shape — rectangular, irregular, or curved.
boundary.freeImagery: Free satellite imagery (no API key required)
boundary.hintStart: Click on the satellite map to start tracing your garden outline.
boundary.hintNeedMore: {{count}} point — add at least 3 to close the shape.
boundary.hintNeedMore_plural: {{count}} points — add at least 3 to close the shape.
boundary.optional: Use the polygon tool to trace the outline. Add extra points to approximate curves. This step is optional — you can adjust dimensions on the next step.
boundary.uploadHint: Upload an aerial photo, map screenshot, or garden plan to trace the boundary
boundary.traceHintStart: Click on the image to place vertices around your garden.
boundary.traceHintNeedMore: {{count}} point placed — add at least 3 to close.
boundary.traceHintNeedMore_plural: {{count}} points placed — add at least 3 to close.
boundary.traceHintReady: {{count}} points — press "Close shape" when the outline is complete.
boundary.scaleTitle: Set scale — how wide is your traced outline in real life?
boundary.scaleHint: The width of your polygon is {{px}} px. Enter the real-world width (e.g. the width of a recognisable feature like a house or driveway).
boundary.traceTip: Tip: for a Google Maps screenshot, zoom in until you can see a recognisable feature (car, door, path) whose real-world size you know. This step is optional — you can adjust dimensions on the next step.
boundary.loadError: Could not load map. Check your connection.
